Title: How can I create my own trims and hardware?
Content: For most cases, custom trims are made in other 3D tools such as Maya and imported into CLO. If 3D modeling is not feasible, you may request to 3D modeling companies. Advanced CLO users can also create trims using Patterns and export as OBJs.

Title: Do you create ______ (some kind of trims & hardwares) for me?
Content: Currently, we do not create custom trims, but custom trim service is on the way. If you need trims other than those provided in CLO, please visit CLO-SET CONNECT and purchase as needed.

Title: What is the purpose of rendering?
Content: Since real-life lighting and reflection are not applied to the 3D environment in CLO, 3D Garments have less realistic look in the 3D window. Therefore, to create photo-realistic 3D Garments, an additional process called rendering which simulates real-life lighting and reflection on the 3D Garment is needed.

Title: I recorded an animation, but the Garment looks very light as if it is floating. What should I do?
Content: The 3D Garment may seem floating in animation when the friction between Avatar and Garment and the friction between Garment and Garment are in low values. Please increase the friction. Or, change the Simulation option from Normal to Complete to express fabric more realistically.

Title: Does CLO come with a rendering solution?
Content: Yes, CLO includes an internal renderer that will allow you to create realistic high-quality images of your 3D garments.

Title: How long does it take to create a 3D garment?
Content: This can range from 2 minutes for a simple t-shirt, to 2 hours for a complex jacket.

Title: Can I animate my garments in CLO?
Content: Yes, after creating garments, you can animate them in Animation Mode in CLO. Please refer to the manuals to learn how to record animations in CLO.

Title: Does CLO offer a version for academic institutions?
Content: Yes, we have CLO for Academic available for academic institutions, but this plan is not open to individual students. Individual students can receive a discount if they use their student email address by checking the student eligibility on the sign-in page. For academic institutions, please contact us for more information. For individual students, please refer to this page.

Title: Can I suspend my subscription period?
Content: No, you cannot suspend your subscription period. The only way to stop your subscription is to cancel your subscription. If you are concerned about the infrequent use, we highly recommend you subscribe to a monthly plan instead of a yearly plan.

Title: I'm using Intel HD Graphic 530 (or 630) and CLO crashes immediately upon launching.
Content: Please refer to the manual, How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card, to solve the issue.

Title: Can I import my own trims and hardware?
Content: Yes. You may import custom trims as OBJs and use the Glue tool to attach and simulate with 3D Garments. To learn how to load OBJ file as trims in more detail, please refer to the manual.

Title: Does CLO provide trims and hardware?
Content: Yes. CLO provides a variety of trims such as buckles, buttons, buttonholes, rings, zippers, and more, which can be found in the CLO Library. If you need trims other than default ones, you may buy in CLO-SET CONNECT.

Title: To what extent can I modify graphics in CLO?
Content: You may perform basic modification on graphics, such as scaling, rotating, changing color, and repeating the graphic along the x-axis and y-axis, and all over the Pattern. To further learn how to edit graphics in CLO, please refer to the Edit Graphics manual.

Title: How are fabrics simulated in CLO?
Content: In CLO, Fabric is expressed as it is made in real life, combining material + prints. Please learn how to configure Physical Properties and create and apply textures.

Title: How often will I get updates to my subscription?
Content: As a subscribed user, you will receive the program's major updates three times a year, and a few minor patch releases in between each major update with bug fixes. To learn more about each version's new features, please visit here.

Title: Can I import my own prints and textures?
Content: Yes, for Prints and Textures CLO supports PNG, JPEG, xTex, Normal and Specular Maps, PSD, AI, and TIFF files. Though to retain any transparent elements of a Print, they must be saved as PNG. For Graphics, CLO supports JPEG, PNG, AI and PSD. PNG and AI are the only file types that support transparent elements. Title: Does CLO come with a fabric database?
Content: Yes. CLO provides approximately 49 Fabrics in the CLO Library. You may also purchase other Fabrics in CLO-SET CONNECT, or can purchase CLO Fabric Kit to measure and calculate custom Fabrics and use in CLO. If you are interested in purchasing CLO Fabric Kit, please contact CLO Global Support Team.

Title: Can I use my subscription offline?
Content: No, CLO for Individuals, a subscription-based plan, cannot be used offline. Please note that your device must be connected to the internet when you log in to access CLO.

Title: If I have a fabric swatch, can it be simulated in CLO?
Content: To accurately simulate your fabric swatch in CLO, you need CLO's Fabric Kit or FDS which needs additional charges. However, Fabric Kit and FDS (Fabric Digitization Service) are ancillary services provided only to companies. The company must be qualified for CLO Business plan (One-person company is not eligible for using the FDS service and Fabric Kit). On the other hand, CLO does provide some emulated fabrics as default assets and you can purchase other varieties of free emulated fabrics in CLO-SET CONNECT which can be modified as needed. Please refer to the manual to learn how to edit fabric properties in CLO. Please contact us if you would like to purchase the Fabric Kit and use the FDS service,

Title: How much is the Fabric kit?
Content: A Fabric kit is an ancillary service provided only to companies that purchased CLO for Business. The company must purchase the Business license before ordering a fabric kit. Please reach out to CLO via Contact Us. For additional fabric inventory, we recommend you explore CLO-SET CONNECT.

Title: If I understand correctly, the Stress Map displays the effect the Avatar has on the Pattern, not the effect the Pattern has on the Avatar. Why did you guys choose this method?
Content: There are many limitations to the Avatar technologies that are available at the moment (muscle and skin deformation are not taken into account, for example), so any calculations on the effect of Pattern on Avatar would not only be difficult but would be inaccurate.

Title: Is it compatible with other CAD?
Content: Yes. You may import patterns created in other 2D CAD programs as DXF-AAMA or ASTM files and vice-versa.

Title: Can I print Patterns from CLO?
How long does it take to make virtual fabric using actual fabric?
Content: It takes about 15 ~20 minutes to create a virtual fabric, performing following three steps: 1. cutting fabric samples, 2. testing fabrics, 3. calculating measurements from the test.

Title: How accurate are virtual fabrics?
Content: There are two ways to emulate fabric properties in CLO as below. To learn more how each method works, please select the desired option. Use Fabrics in CLO Library Create with Fabric Kit All Fabrics provided in the CLO Library and Fabrics created with the Fabric Kit have 90% of accuracy. However, the accuracy may differ when Fabrics' Physical Properties are arbitrarily modified. Use Fabrics in CLO Library Navigate to the Fabric folder in the CLO Library to use Fabrics come with CLO. Those Fabrics are emulated with the Fabric kit, measuring Stretch, Bending and other Physical Properties and are about 90% accurate. Create with Fabric Kit If you would like to emulate own fabrics by measuring their Stretch, Bending and others, you may purchase CLO Fabric Kit. If you are interested in purchasing CLO Fabric Kit, please contact the CLO Global Support Team.

Title: Can I import 3D body scan data into CLO?
Content: Yes, 3D body scans can be imported into CLO as long as they are in OBJ or FBX file format. However, the body mesh has to be "cleaned" (no holes or noises) so that garments can be fitted correctly.

Title: I cannot import my AI as patterns. How can I fix the problem?
Content: There can be more than one reason why cannot import your AI files as patterns. Please refer to the manual, Troubleshooting AI Import Failures, to find out the solution meets your need.

Title: How can I make a feature request?
Content: We have a Product Feedback forum dedicated to collect users' feedback on our program. To submit a feature request, please click here.

Title: Where can I find information on new features of CLO?
Content: You can find information about the new CLO features on the following page: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Title: Does CLO have an online community?
Content: Yes! CLO has an online community which you can join to help each other and show your expertise in CLO. Please follow the link to access the community.
